verdict: Only with a sharp focus. Medu Lance pitched a one-stop healthcare app on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from three sharks. One-stop apps are hard to win against large players, so start with one service, such as ambulance booking or home care, in one city.
angle: Patients want one place for doctors, tests, medicines and ambulances, but large platforms already offer this in metros. Smaller cities and specific services such as emergency response or elder care still have gaps.
